office_does: The assessor values every taxable property in Spokane County each year for property taxes and runs exemption programs such as the senior and disabled-persons exemption.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Tom Konis (Prefers Republican Party), assessor since 2019, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Incumbent Spokane County Assessor since 2019, with the office since 1993 as an appraiser; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Assessor since 2019; joined the office as an appraiser in 1993 [S1]
Credits his office with technology upgrades and cites work on SSB 6162 property-tax relief for seniors, disabled residents and disabled veterans [S1]
Promoted the senior and disabled-persons property-tax exemption in a 2025 op-ed with Treasurer Mike Volz [S2]
